observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates 10 basic jazz dance moves one by one while providing verbal breakdowns. She maintains an encouraging and upbeat tone throughout the tutorial.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the rapid fire listicle of 10 basic jazz dance moves.

cues: Arms open close in a circle

steps_taught.name: Jazz Walks
steps_taught.description: Walking across the floor in jazz style.

steps_taught.name: Ball Change
steps_taught.description: Stepping on the ball of the foot and changing weight.

steps_taught.name: Chainé Turns
steps_taught.description: Linked turns rotating in a circle.

steps_taught.name: Piqué Turn
steps_taught.description: Pricked turn stepping directly onto pointe or half-pointe.

steps_taught.name: Battement
steps_taught.description: High kick with straight legs and pointed toes.

steps_taught.name: Chassé
steps_taught.description: Gallop step chasing one foot with the other.

steps_taught.name: Jazz Leap
steps_taught.description: Leaping across the room with arms in a high V.

what_works: On-screen text labels for each movement name
Clear verbal instructions alongside visual demonstration
what_hinders: Pacing is very fast as a rapid-fire list

quotes.text: Today we're doing a rapid fire listicle, 10 basic jazz dance.
